reference_feasibility.method: Repository validation constructs a schema-valid reference output for every task and deterministically regrades it.

independent_domain_review.note: Two qualified radiation-therapy physicists must independently review every task before the release may be described as domain-reviewed.

human_baseline.note: No human performance score is published. The preregistered collection protocol is in docs/HUMAN_BASELINE_PROTOCOL.md.

paired_counterfactuals.note: No release-matched paired counterfactual variants are published for the ten workflow-view tasks.

negative_controls.note: No release-matched negative-control fixtures are published for the ten workflow-view tasks.

data_rights_review.note: The official OpenKBP code/data repository and pinned dataset mirror declare MIT terms; CT origin and upstream challenge attribution are retained. Independent publication-rights review remains required before promoting the pilot beyond provisional status.

allowed: Provisional common-harness model comparison on two pinned OpenKBP patient families
Research-only evidence about bounded assistance and escalation behavior
prohibited: Clinical validation or treatment-planning competence claim
Stateful or end-to-end workflow completion claim
